Proof. The image of \(\bd \) is the set of integer vectors summing to zero on each component, a sublattice of \(\ZZ ^{V}\) of rank \(|V(\quiv )| - c\); this is [1, Proposition 2.1]. Since \(\Zcyc (\quiv ) = \ker \bd \) is saturated by Proposition  2.6, the sequence \(0 \to \Zcyc (\quiv ) \to W(\quiv ) \to \operatorname {im} \bd \to 0\) is exact and \(\operatorname {im} \bd \) is free, so it splits and the ranks add, which gives ( 3). □
